Emily —

Thanks for the packet and for the quick turnaround. Short answer: yes, we can accept a notarized affidavit plus a bank confirmation letter to satisfy TIN/evidence for PO activation, but procurement needs the documents to meet two checks before we can schedule the PO:

1) ID parity: the authorized signatory name on the affidavit must exactly match the entity name and the signatory in your W-8BEN-E.
2) Bank letter: must be on bank letterhead, include the account holder entity name and account number suffix, and be dated within the last 90 days.

Preferred flows (ranked):
- DocuSign notary flow (preferred) — fastest and preserves audit trail.
- Wet-ink notarized affidavit scanned + bank letter notarized — acceptable if the signatory is clearly identified and the scan legible.

Can you send a scanned sample of the notarized affidavit when available? If you go DocuSign, please include the envelope link in the reply and we will confirm receipt.

I am looping in Karthik from vendor onboarding (procurement) to confirm the PO gate once docs clear. Marcus — FYI on potential timing, this is a ~$120k one-off purchase to be issued to SageGrid next week if we can clear docs by Thursday.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager
